description: Calculate traditional 36-point Ashtakoot (Guna Milan, gun milan, Kundli matching) compatibility for two consenting people, with Moon, Lagna, chart positions, and dosha flags. Order does not matter. Before calling, if the user has not said each person's gender, ask once (it is optional; pass none if they would rather not say). With one man and one woman the man is read as the groom (Varna and Vashya are directional); otherwise those two kootas are averaged over both orders. reading_order in the result says which rule applied. Do not frame the score as a command to start or end a relationship. Use city, region and country for a place. If a place is not found, ask the user to clarify it before trying another tool with the same place. Use only verified latitude and longitude; never guess coordinates.

date.description: Local birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Ask the user if it is unclear; do not infer it.

latitude.description: Verified latitude from -90 to 90, supplied with longitude. Never guess coordinates.

longitude.description: Verified longitude from -180 to 180, supplied with latitude. Never guess coordinates.

place.description: Birth city, region and country. Ask for clarification if unresolved before retrying in any tool. Do not silently substitute a different location.

time.description: Local birth time in 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format, without a UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, or omit to derive it from the verified birth location.
